overviewParagraphs: Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort is Vietnam's island golf showcase — a spectacular tropical course on Phu Quoc Island where the South China Sea serves as the defining visual backdrop and strategic companion throughout the round. Located in one of Southeast Asia's fastest-growing resort destinations, it combines pristine natural beauty with championship-standard conditioning.

The layout hugs the coastline, with several holes played directly along the ocean's edge rewarding bold play with unforgettable vistas. The vegetation is lush, raw, and tropical — a deliberate contrast to the manicured resort aesthetic found at many competitor layouts, giving Vung Bau an authentic, adventurous character.

For discerning golfers extending their Vietnam itinerary to include Phu Quoc Island, Eschuri Vung Bau is the natural headline course. AGS can build full island packages incorporating golf, beach resorts, and island excursions for extended Vietnam travel experiences.

curatorBriefHtml: Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort (opened 2024 on Phu Quoc Island’s northwest coast) brings genuine architectural pedigree to Vietnam’s premier island destination. Designed by IMG, the Par 72 layout measures 6,865 yards from the Blue Tees and intentionally transitions from lush interior jungle corridors on the front nine out toward sweeping Gulf of Thailand beachfront holes on the closing stretch.

What separates Eschuri Vung Bau from older resort courses on Phu Quoc is its deliberate pacing and sunset climax: holes 14 through 16 hug the Vung Bau shoreline, turning an afternoon tee time into a golden-hour oceanfront finish before heading straight to the beachfront clubhouse. Fairways are welcoming off the tee while green surrounds reward creative bump-and-run recovery shots.

Because Phu Quoc enjoys a distinct dry season from November through April — right when Central Vietnam can still see lingering monsoon showers — Eschuri Vung Bau is a prime winter-sun anchor for Australian and international groups seeking warm 28–31°C beach-and-golf escapes with direct domestic flights from Ho Chi Minh City (1 hour) or Hanoi (2 hours).

scorecard.verdict: Phu Quoc Island's latest luxury golf statement. Seamlessly integrated between virgin tropical forests and the calm waters of Vung Bau Bay, delivering an unforgettable island golf escape.

faqs.q: What makes Eschuri Vung Bau Golf Resort stand out on Phu Quoc Island?
faqs.a: Opened in 2024 and designed by IMG, Eschuri Vung Bau blends a quiet tropical forest front nine with direct beachfront holes along Vung Bau Bay on the back nine — giving Phu Quoc a true luxury championship alternative with standout sunset views.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play golf in Phu Quoc?
faqs.a: November through April is Phu Quoc’s dry season, offering calm seas, low rainfall, and warm 28–31°C sunshine. It is one of the most reliable winter-sun golf windows in Southeast Asia while Da Nang and Hanoi are cooler.

faqs.q: How far is Eschuri Vung Bau from Phu Quoc International Airport (PQC)?
faqs.a: The course lies on Phu Quoc’s tranquil northwest coast, roughly 40 to 45 minutes north of Phu Quoc International Airport (PQC) by private transfer, and 15 to 25 minutes from northwest luxury beach resorts.

faqs.q: How many rounds should golfers plan on a Phu Quoc extension?
faqs.a: Most AGS guests spend 3 to 4 nights on Phu Quoc as a relaxing southern finale after Saigon/Ho Tram or Da Nang, playing 2 rounds at Eschuri Vung Bau (one morning, one twilight sunset round) alongside beach and island downtime.
